instruction: Inspect observations.json and write classification.json. For each artifact ID, classify the most specific binary format and architecture warranted by the available bytes and container-entry observations, without inventing missing evidence. Use only the following class values: PE32_PLUS_X86_64, MACH_O_ARM64, ELF_AARCH64, ANDROID_APK_CANDIDATE, IOS_IPA_CANDIDATE, DEX, WASM, UNKNOWN_RAW. Select one next_action per item from GHIDRA_STATIC, VERIFY_CONTAINER, DEX_ANALYSIS, WASM_ANALYSIS, RECOVER_CONTEXT. Produce a JSON object with exactly schema_version=1 and artifacts; each artifacts entry has exactly class, next_action and evidence_refs. evidence_refs must be a nonempty array of distinct RFC 6901 references to actual fields in observations.json, in the form observations.json#/artifacts/<artifact_id>/<field>. Do not edit observations.json. A ZIP signature plus an entry listing supports a package candidate, not a validated device-runnable application. An unverified raw dump must remain unknown unless metadata proves its architecture.
